title: Yellowed Argentinian Meat Dumplings
description: A traditional Argentinian dish featuring tender meat dumplings in a rich ginger garlic sauce, served with a side of low-carb friendly vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, ginger garlic paste, onion, egg, almond flour, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Drizzle the olive oil over the dumplings and gently roll them to coat evenly.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the dumplings are baking, heat the chicken broth in a small saucepan over medium heat until warmed through.
Serve the dumplings in the warmed chicken broth, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
